matches.rationale: The ground truth records that the argument supporting Theorem 2.1 fails because a needed condition/exception is not accounted for, so the result is claimed too generally. Finding 1 targets exactly the proof of Theorem 2.1 and exhibits a counterexample satisfying all of the paper's stated conditions (Condition 4.1, bounded open D) for which the key displayed identity fails, i.e. the step holds only under an extra (symmetry) restriction. Same material and same defect, so it is credited under R1/R3.
